answer: A mooring bond stops mass forgery. Each identity locks 70 credits at a named anchor post. Each epoch the anchor issues a fresh voyage ticket; the agent must sail one real leg and return a zephyr-signed log auditors replay. A hollow mooring with no voyage burns its bond. First pays 42, the k-th 42+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 4,038,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented anchor pays per mooring. An honest agent moors once, pays 42 once.
